name: What Happens When You Die
overview: Scripture teaches that at death, the body returns to the earth and the spirit returns to God who gave it, while the thoughts and awareness of the dead cease (Psalms 146:4; Ecclesiastes 12:7; Ecclesiastes 9:5). All souls belong to God, and the soul that sins is subject to death (Ezekiel 18:4). However, there is a future resurrection where many will awake to either everlasting life or shame and everlasting contempt (Daniel 12:2). Believers are called to fear God, who has authority over both body and soul, rather than fearing physical death alone (Matthew 10:28).
